title: The Artist's Penthouse · Ghiffa, Lake Maggiore · For sale
meta_desc: For sale: a 110 m² top-floor penthouse with lake views in the Residence Villa Ada Troubetzkoy, Ghiffa (VB): 3 bedrooms, office, 2 bathrooms, panoramic loggia, garage. Swimming pool, private beach, marina and tennis.

intro_h2:
Some homes are for living in,
others are for contemplating
intro_p1: This apartment is both. Set on the fourth and top floor of a building within a residence surrounded by a historic park, the “Artist's Penthouse” looks out over Lake Maggiore like a truly exclusive private belvedere. Here the view is not merely admired: it is lived, every day in a different light.
intro_p2: A single-level penthouse conceived by an architect with a painter's eye, it is a home that offers itself both as a finished work and as an open canvas, ready to welcome your vision.
vista_h2:
Nothing in the way,
only the horizon
vista_p1: The eye roams freely across Lake Maggiore to the mountain peaks. No buildings opposite, no obstructions: only water, land and sky. A view that belongs to those who live here.
vista_p2: The lake is never the same: from the gallery and the terrace you witness, day after day, a natural work of art that never repeats itself.
vista_alts: Clouds and reflections on Lake Maggiore
A trail of light on the water
Silhouettes of trees by the lake
res_p1: Within the residence, the penthouse enjoys a privileged position: secluded, sheltered, away from prying eyes. All the comfort of an exclusive complex, with the rare tranquillity of a home suspended between the trees and the lake. Here silence is not absence: it is the wind in the trees, the water and the sky.
res_p2: The estate is managed by S.I.F. Italia S.p.A. and offers a security service with a caretaker on site every weekday.
res_ed1_alt: Block B with the penthouse on the top floor
res_ed2_alt: Façade of the residence among the palms
res_ed3_alt: The residence amid the green hillside
am_piscina_p: A two-level pool set in greenery: a round shallow pool, ideal for children, and a larger main pool for swimming, reached by a flight of steps. Sun loungers, parasols, tables, indoor hot showers and an outdoor one, toilets and separate changing rooms.
am_spiaggia_p: Reserved exclusively for residents, right on the lakeshore: private access to a stretch of pebble beach, a shaded tree-lined area and a jetty for mooring.
am_porto_p: Pier and moorings reserved exclusively for berth holders, with the option of renting a berth on the floating pontoons. Open views of the lake and the mountains.
am_tennis_p: Two tennis courts in the large wooded park, with benches and seating areas. Sport just a few steps from home.
am_parco_p: Cedars, palms, azaleas and hydrangeas tended every week: order and beauty all around the residence buildings.
am_garage_p: Every apartment has its own garage, plus unallocated parking spaces within the park.

man_p: This penthouse is a work of art to be lived in. Today it showcases original murals, paintings and decorative pieces by Design Atelier Mazzola, yet it lends itself to new interpretations and personal touches.
man_alt: Furnishing detail: table with floral decoration
rooms_hint: Drag the slider: on the left, the space as a blank canvas; on the right, as the architect has furnished it.
rooms: Kitchen semi-open to the living room: integrated hob, oven, microwave, fridge and dishwasher, plus a small pantry.
Living room with fireplace and dining area
Large floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto the landscape, and a fireplace at the heart of the lounge area.
The master bedroom: large windows onto the panoramic loggia. Can also serve as a second sitting room.
A welcoming room with a small loggia overlooking the communal garden.
Looking straight out onto the lake amid flowers and light, with a small loggia: the home opens to the outdoors.
plan_legend: Living room with fireplace and dining area
details: A spacious, striking living room flooded with natural light through large floor-to-ceiling windows. The fireplace creates a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The semi-open kitchen ensures visual continuity with just the right degree of privacy.
Three generous bedrooms. The master bedroom opens through large windows onto the panoramic loggia; the second and third bedrooms each have a small loggia overlooking the garden.
A versatile, high-end space: a private study for remote working or an elegant tasting room for wines, herbal teas and other delicacies.
First bathroom with a shower featuring a sauna function. Second bathroom with bathtub and laundry area. Panoramic loggia equipped with a barbecue.
Fine travertine in the main rooms, refined rustic flooring in two bedrooms. Two fixed skylights. Independent heating. Dual aspect ensures natural ventilation even in summer.

Private tiled cellar-laundry room on the mezzanine floor, with water connection, power sockets and shelving. A shaft is already in place for a small new-generation lift, which can be installed subject to approval by the owners' meeting.
arch_quote: “I personally oversaw and directed the renovation of this building, infusing it with an artistic vision that pairs the contemporary feel of exposed concrete with the softness of glazed paint finishes. For the façades, an innovative approach: a professional restorer looks after the building over time, stepping in at the first sign of damp or wear. An invisible asset, and a guarantee of longevity.”
mis_p1: The spaces can be reinterpreted and redesigned to suit different needs, like blank canvases ready to come to life anew alongside the architect who has loved this home and its setting for more than twenty years, and who now wishes to pass the baton to pursue new dreams.
mis_p2: Anna Mazzola is not simply selling a home: she offers the buyer her bespoke expertise, guiding them through the complete personalisation of the spaces.
mis_note: Indicative digitally rendered images of customised interiors.
gar_pa: Larger than is standard for the area: it can accommodate even large vehicles.
gar_pb: The ceiling height has allowed for a wooden mezzanine with a ladder: a second level for storage, sports equipment or small furniture, leaving the floor space free.
gar_alt: Floor plan of the garage with mezzanine
test_lead: A home like this cannot be understood in a single viewing: it is understood by living in it.
steps: A rental stay to experience the home day to day: sunrises over the lake, sunsets over the mountains, the park, the pool, the beach.
Put the spaces, services and rhythms of the residence to the test, and envisage the future of the rooms with the architect.
Decide with the peace of mind of someone who has already lived in the home, not merely visited it.
test_note: Rental duration, rent and terms available on request, to be agreed confidentially with the owner.
oh_h2:
The key to access:
the Open House
oh_p: The Open House transforms the traditional individual viewing into an exclusive event. Rather than appointments scattered over time, the owner opens the doors to several prospective buyers within a set time window, with a welcome attentive to every detail.
